opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together across fields such as arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport. Supports festivals, workshops, exchanges, collaborative projects, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in medicine and health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration is also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference is given to those not previously involved in UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career applicants. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. Funds can be used for travel, conference, publication costs, and other project expenses, up to £10,000 per year for up to three years.
